title: Review of c33's phoretic SIMD packs: replicates on fresh seed 6 (27 labkit persistent splits, generation 11; one lineage travels 4.0 diameters merger-free and then splits, but its smaller daughter keeps only 6% B)
summary: Re-ran the claimed world (identical to 20261026T0529's) on seed 6 to t=800 with labkit and with c33's screen.py + lineage.py (particle identity). labkit: 27 persistent splits, max generation 11, merge/split 1.31, 101 tracks moving >= 1 body length (max 10.2). lineage.py: 43 persistent splits (40 with B in both daughters, >= 5%), generation 7; 1 parent travelled >= 3 diameters since birth or last merge before dividing: track 211, a capped composite of 83-98 particles, travels 4.0 diameters along a smooth curve (t=378-574) and splits into 64 + 31 with B shares 0.27 and 0.06 (swimdivide_seed6_track211.png: the small daughter is almost capless). Together with my seed-5 review of the parent claim (2 such lineages of 46), swim-then-divide in one lineage happens but is a tail event.

observations.I: rerun/seed6/particles.png: discrete A clusters with B caps
observations.M: swimdivide_seed6_track211.png: 4.0 diameters merger-free, t=378-574, smooth path, 83-98 particles
observations.D: rerun/seed6/lineage.png: 27 persistent splits, generation 11; track 211 itself divides 95 -> 64 + 31 at t=574

seeds_run.result: pass (1 swim-then-divide lineage among 43 persistent splits; one daughter nearly capless)

controls_run.M: reciprocal twin run in my review of the parent claim, 20261026T0904-c39-review-phoretic-swimdivide/recip/seed5: max 2.7 body lengths

verdicts.limitation: Only one swim-then-divide lineage on seed 6 (1/43 persistent splits), and its smaller daughter keeps only 6% B, so 'both daughters keep the cap' fails for this event; the joint M+D life is rare. Motion and division are each common in the population. The particle turnover ledger is imposed chemistry. One fresh seed.
